## Motivation

MoE DiTs are growing, and SP shards activations but not experts: every rank still stores all routed experts. This PR adds expert parallelism (EP) to SGLang Diffusion, with LingBot-Video MoE (128 routed experts) as the first supported model. On 2×H100, EP2 cuts peak memory by 26.2 GB/GPU (43%) for 12% more latency.

## Modifications

Two commits:

1. **Fix LingBot SP.** LingBot under SP produced wrong output before this PR (RoPE positions restarted at zero on every rank, and replicated text was gathered as distinct shards). It now shards video tokens inside the DiT, slices global RoPE positions per rank, and passes text as `num_replicated_suffix`. 81 frames are no longer rounded to 85. EP depends on this.
2. **Add EP.** `--ep-size`, a per-pipeline capability gate, expert-sharded checkpoint loading, and a fixed-capacity dispatcher.

**Design decision: EP reuses the SP group (`ep_size == sp_degree`).** SP already gives every rank the same token count, so dispatch is one equal-split all-to-all with static shapes and no host sync. Non-local routes carry a `-1` expert ID and are masked; partials are reduced in FP32 by the existing `moe_fused_mul_sum`.

| Alternative considered | Result | Decision |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Replicated tokens (no SP) | 1711 vs 1245 ms/step | Keep SP; replication duplicates attention |
| Variable-split Torch dispatcher | 1133 vs 1051 ms/step, ~20× more variance | Fixed capacity; no per-block host sync |
| Eager / compiled reducer | 3.64 / 1.07 vs 0.211 ms | Reuse `moe_fused_mul_sum` |

## Scope and scaling

- Qualified: EP2/SP2, single-node CUDA, LingBot-Video MoE. Other valid topologies are accepted but unmeasured.
- Rejected with EP: FSDP inference, `torch.compile`, disaggregated serving, live full-weight updates (LoRA updates still work).
- LingBot SP rejects dynamic batching and requires the video token count to divide by the SP degree.
- Dispatch traffic grows linearly with `ep_size`. Large EP (`ep_size ≫ sp_degree`) needs an independent EP group and a route-aware transport; the `dispatch`/`combine` interface allows swapping it in later.

## Accuracy Tests

- **MoE block:** EP vs dense relative Frobenius error 2.96e-3 (limit 5e-3); repeated runs are bit-identical per topology.
- **Full DiT (2 GPUs):** tiny LingBot DiT, dense vs SP2 and dense vs SP2+EP2, both pass.
- **Real model:** 81-frame videos from 1 GPU, SP2, and SP2+EP2 are coherent with no shard seams. EP is not bit-exact, so 40 steps turn small BF16 differences into a different sample for the same seed; a 2-step run confirms all three start from the same noise.
- Unit and kernel suites pass (296 tests on H100).

## Speed Tests and Profiling

2×H100, SP2 (`--ulysses-degree 2`), 81 frames, 480×480, 40 steps, BF16, one warmed-up request per configuration.

| Configuration | Denoise | Request | Peak memory/GPU |
| --- | ---: | ---: | ---: |
| SP2 + EP1 | 1.70 it/s | 27.04 s | 61.2 GB |
| SP2 + EP2 | 1.43 it/s | 30.27 s | **35.1 GB** |

EP2: +12% latency, −26.2 GB/GPU, matching the expected halving of ~54 GB of routed experts.

## Checklist

- [x] Format your code according to the [Format code with pre-commit](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#format-code-with-pre-commit).
- [x] Add unit tests according to the [Run and add unit tests](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#run-and-add-unit-tests).
- [x] Update documentation according to [Write documentations](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#write-documentations).
- [x] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results according to [Test the accuracy](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#test-the-accuracy) and [Benchmark the speed](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#benchmark-the-speed).
- [x] Follow the SGLang code style [guidance](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#code-style-guidance).

+---
+title: "Expert Parallelism"
+description: "Shard LingBot-Video MoE experts across an SP-aligned GPU group."
+---
+
+Expert parallelism (EP) reduces per-GPU memory by sharding a Mixture-of-Experts
+DiT's routed expert weights. Each GPU runs its local experts, while the router
+and shared expert remain replicated.
+
+## Enable EP
+
+Set `ep_size` to the number of GPUs in the sequence-parallel group. For example:
+
+```bash
+sglang generate \
+  --model-path robbyant/lingbot-video-moe-30b-a3b \
+  --num-gpus 2 \
+  --ep-size 2 \
+  --ulysses-degree 2 \
+  --prompt "A robotic arm moves a red cube on a white table" \
+  --save-output
+```
+
+## Requirements and compatibility
+
+| Setting | Current support |
+| --- | --- |
+| Model | Native LingBot-Video MoE pipeline |
+| Platform | NVIDIA CUDA or AMD ROCm |
+| EP degree | `1` disables EP; values greater than `1` enable it |
+| Serving mode | Monolithic |
+| Sequence parallelism | `ep_size = sp_degree`; Ulysses, Ring, and K/V-gather follow their existing constraints |
+| Attention heads | With Ulysses, the TP-local head count must be divisible by `ulysses_degree` |
+| Routed experts | The expert count must be divisible by `ep_size` |
+| FSDP inference | Not supported with EP |
+| `torch.compile` | Not supported with EP |
+| Offload | DiT layerwise offload is supported with EP |
+| Dynamic batching | Not supported with SP or EP |
+
+## Parallel layout
+
+EP reuses the full SP group for expert ownership and token exchange. It does
+not add another factor to the physical GPU count:
+
+```text
+num_gpus = dp_size × cfg_parallel_degree × tp_size × sp_degree
+ep_size = sp_degree
+```
+
+LingBot-Video MoE shards video patch tokens across the SP group and keeps the
+text suffix replicated. Each SP rank sends its local routed token rows to every
+EP rank. A destination rank computes only the routes assigned to its local
+experts, then returns one partial result per source row. The video outputs are
+gathered once after the final DiT block. Model-level sequence sharding is
+enabled automatically and cannot be disabled when `sp_degree` is greater than
+one.
+
+Hidden-state traffic grows with `ep_size`. Benchmark larger degrees and
+multi-node layouts on the target topology before deployment.
+
+For the other parallel axes, see
+[Parallelism in SGLang Diffusion](/docs/sglang-diffusion/parallelism).
+
+## Performance tradeoff
+
+EP reduces routed-expert memory while preserving sequence-parallel attention.
+Token dispatch adds communication to each MoE block, so benchmark against the
+same SP configuration without EP. Earlier measurements made before LingBot's
+model-level sequence sharding fix are not comparable.
+
+## Numerical behavior
+
+EP is deterministic for a fixed topology and input, but it is not bit-exact
+with the dense path. EP applies routing weights and groups FP32 reductions at
+different points around BF16 rounding. Long denoising trajectories can amplify
+those small per-block differences into a different video sample.
+
+Use an EP-specific reference output for consistency testing instead of comparing
+EP output against a dense reference.
+
+## Weight loading and updates
+
+Checkpoint loading retains only the contiguous routed-expert shard owned by each
+rank. With `--direct-gpu-weight-loading`, each full expert tensor reaches the GPU
+before it is sliced, so EP reduces resident memory but not the transient
+load-time peak.
+
+Live full-weight updates to the EP-sharded DiT are rejected. Restart the server
+to load new DiT weights. LoRA updates remain supported.

+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import math
+import os
+import subprocess
+import sys
+import unittest
+from types import SimpleNamespace
+
+import torch
+
+from sglang.test.test_utils import CustomTestCase, find_available_port
+
+_WORLD = 2
+_REL_FRO_LIMIT = 1e-2
+# (ulysses_degree, ring_degree, kv_gather_degree); kv_gather runs on the Ulysses layout.
+_SP_MODES = {
+    "ulysses": (_WORLD, 1, 1),
+    "ring": (1, _WORLD, 1),
+    "kv_gather": (_WORLD, 1, _WORLD),
+}
+
+
+def _build_tiny_dit():
+    from sglang.multimodal_gen.configs.models.dits.lingbot_video_moe import (
+        LingBotVideoMoEConfig,
+    )
+    from sglang.multimodal_gen.runtime.models.dits.lingbot_video_moe import (
+        LingBotVideoTransformer3DModel,
+    )
+
+    config = LingBotVideoMoEConfig()
+    config.update_model_arch(
+        dict(
+            hidden_size=128,
+            num_attention_heads=2,
+            axes_dims=(16, 24, 24),
+            depth=2,
+            intermediate_size=256,
+            text_dim=32,
+            freq_dim=32,
+            num_experts=16,
+            moe_intermediate_size=32,
+        )
+    )
+    return LingBotVideoTransformer3DModel(config, {}).eval()
+
+
+def _worker_impl(sp_mode: str) -> int:
+    import torch.distributed as dist
+
+    from sglang.multimodal_gen.configs.pipeline_configs.lingbot_video_moe import (
+        LingBotVideoMoEPipelineConfig,
+    )
+    from sglang.multimodal_gen.runtime.distributed.parallel_state import (
+        maybe_init_distributed_environment_and_model_parallel,
+    )
+    from sglang.multimodal_gen.runtime.layers.attention.selector import (
+        global_force_attn_backend,
+    )

+    )
+    from sglang.multimodal_gen.runtime.platforms import AttentionBackendEnum
+    from sglang.multimodal_gen.runtime.server_args import set_global_server_args
+    from sglang.multimodal_gen.runtime.utils.precision import (

+    )
+    from sglang.srt.runtime_context import get_context
+    from sglang.srt.server_args import ServerArgs as SrtServerArgs
+
+    rank = int(os.environ["RANK"])

+    if get_context()._server_args is None:
+        get_context().set_server_args(SrtServerArgs(model_path="dummy"))
+    ulysses_degree, ring_degree, kv_gather_degree = _SP_MODES[sp_mode]
+    maybe_init_distributed_environment_and_model_parallel(
+        tp_size=1,
+        sp_size=_WORLD,
+        ulysses_degree=ulysses_degree,
+        ring_degree=ring_degree,
+    )
+    set_mixed_precision_policy(torch.bfloat16, torch.float32)
+    global_force_attn_backend(AttentionBackendEnum.FA)
+    set_global_server_args(
+        SimpleNamespace(
+            attention_backend="fa",
+            attention_backend_config=None,
+            kv_gather_degree=kv_gather_degree,
+            sp_split_auto=False,
+            pipeline_config=LingBotVideoMoEPipelineConfig(),
+        )
+    )
+
+    dense = _build_tiny_dit()
+    generator = torch.Generator(device="cpu").manual_seed(31)
+    with torch.no_grad():
+        for parameter in dense.parameters():
+            parameter.copy_(torch.randn(parameter.shape, generator=generator) * 0.02)
+    sequence_parallel = _build_tiny_dit()
+    sequence_parallel.load_state_dict(dense.state_dict())
+
+    def tensor(*shape):
+        return torch.randn(*shape, generator=generator).cuda().to(torch.bfloat16)
+
+    inputs = dict(
+        hidden_states=tensor(1, 16, 3, 4, 4),
+        timestep=torch.tensor([500.0], device="cuda"),
+        encoder_hidden_states=tensor(1, 7, 32),
+    )
+    outputs = []
+    for model, enable_sequence_shard in (
+        (dense, False),
+        (sequence_parallel, True),
+    ):
+        model = model.to(device="cuda", dtype=torch.bfloat16)
+        with (
+            torch.no_grad(),
+            set_forward_context(
+                current_timestep=0,
+                attn_metadata=None,
+                forward_batch=SimpleNamespace(

+
+def _worker(sp_mode: str) -> int:
+    from sglang.multimodal_gen.runtime.distributed import cleanup_dist_env_and_memory

+    try:

+    finally:

+"""Two-rank EP checkpoint slicing, dispatch, and end-to-end parity."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import math
+import os
+import subprocess
+import sys
+import unittest
+from types import SimpleNamespace
+from typing import TYPE_CHECKING
+
+import torch
+
+from sglang.test.test_utils import CustomTestCase, find_available_port
+
+if TYPE_CHECKING:
+    from sglang.multimodal_gen.runtime.layers.moe import (
+        LingBotVideoSparseMoeBlock,
+        MoeExpertParallelInfo,
+    )
+
+_NUM_EXPERTS = 32
+_HIDDEN = 64
+_INTERMEDIATE = 32
+_TOP_K = 8
+_DENSE_PARITY_REL_FRO_LIMIT = 5e-3
+_FULL_DIT_REL_FRO_LIMIT = 1e-2
+
+
+def _build_block(
+    num_experts: int,
+    *,
+    ep_info: MoeExpertParallelInfo | None = None,
+) -> LingBotVideoSparseMoeBlock:
+    from sglang.multimodal_gen.runtime.layers.moe import LingBotVideoSparseMoeBlock
+
+    return (
+        LingBotVideoSparseMoeBlock(
+            hidden_size=_HIDDEN,
+            intermediate_size=_INTERMEDIATE,
+            num_experts=num_experts,
+            top_k=_TOP_K,
+            score_func="sigmoid",
+            norm_topk_prob=True,
+            n_group=4,
+            topk_group=2,
+            routed_scaling_factor=2.5,
+            n_shared_experts=1,
+            ep_info=ep_info,
+        )
+        .cuda()
+        .to(torch.bfloat16)
+    )
+
+
+def _set_router(block, num_experts: int, seed: int) -> None:
+    gen = torch.Generator(device="cpu").manual_seed(seed)
+    with torch.no_grad():
+        block.router.weight.copy_(
+            torch.randn(num_experts, _HIDDEN, generator=gen).cuda()
+        )
+        block.router.e_score_correction_bias.copy_(torch.zeros(num_experts).cuda())
+
+
+def _set_shared_experts(block, seed: int) -> None:
+    assert block.shared_experts is not None
+    block.shared_experts.to(dtype=torch.bfloat16)
+    gen = torch.Generator(device="cpu").manual_seed(seed)
+    with torch.no_grad():
+        for param in block.shared_experts.parameters():
+            param.copy_(torch.randn(param.shape, generator=gen).to(param))
+
+
+def _append_dispatch_dense_parity_failure(
+    *,
+    block: LingBotVideoSparseMoeBlock,
+    x: torch.Tensor,
+    full_w1: torch.Tensor,
+    full_w2: torch.Tensor,
+    full_w3: torch.Tensor,
+    label: str,
+    failures: list[str],
+) -> None:
+    with torch.no_grad():
+        dispatched_out = block(x)
+
+    dense = _build_block(_NUM_EXPERTS)
+    dense.router = block.router
+    assert dense.shared_experts is not None
+    assert block.shared_experts is not None
+    dense.shared_experts.load_state_dict(block.shared_experts.state_dict())
+    with torch.no_grad():
+        dense.experts.w13_weight.copy_(torch.cat((full_w1, full_w3), dim=1).cuda())
+        dense.experts.w2.copy_(full_w2.cuda())
+        dense_out = dense(x)
+    if not torch.isfinite(dispatched_out).all().item():
+        failures.append(f"{label} token-dispatch EP output contains NaN or Inf")
+        return
+    if not torch.isfinite(dense_out).all().item():
+        failures.append(f"{label} dense output contains NaN or Inf")
+        return
+
+    # no_combine rounds BF16 in a different order than the dense path.
+    diff = dispatched_out.float() - dense_out.float()
+    rel_fro = (
+        torch.linalg.vector_norm(diff) / torch.linalg.vector_norm(dense_out.float())
+    ).item()
+    if not math.isfinite(rel_fro) or rel_fro > _DENSE_PARITY_REL_FRO_LIMIT:
+        failures.append(
+            f"{label} token-dispatch EP exceeds the dense relative-Frobenius tolerance: "
+            f"relF={rel_fro:.3e} (limit {_DENSE_PARITY_REL_FRO_LIMIT:.1e})"
+        )
+
+

+    *,
+    rank: int,
+    world: int,
+    failures: list[str],
+) -> None:

+        pack_expert_weights,
+    )

+    info = resolve_moe_expert_parallel(_NUM_EXPERTS, ep_size=world)

+    gen = torch.Generator(device="cpu").manual_seed(23)
+    full_w1 = torch.randn(_NUM_EXPERTS, _INTERMEDIATE, _HIDDEN, generator=gen)
+    full_w2 = torch.randn(_NUM_EXPERTS, _HIDDEN, _INTERMEDIATE, generator=gen)

+            topk_weights=torch.empty((1, 1), device="cuda"),

+        )
+
+
+def test_ep_masking_skips_invalid_nan_slots_and_accumulates_in_fp32():
+    expert_outputs = torch.tensor(
+        [
+            [[2.0, 4.0], [torch.nan, torch.nan]],
+            [[torch.nan, torch.nan], [6.0, 8.0]],
+            [[torch.nan, torch.nan], [torch.nan, torch.nan]],
+        ],
+        dtype=torch.bfloat16,
+        device="cuda",
+    )
+    topk_weights = torch.tensor(
+        [[0.25, 0.0], [0.0, 0.5], [0.0, 0.0]],
+        dtype=torch.bfloat16,
+        device="cuda",
+    )
+    topk_ids = torch.tensor(
+        [[0, -1], [-1, 1], [-1, -1]],
+        dtype=torch.int32,
+        device="cuda",
+    )
+    output = torch.empty((3, 2), dtype=torch.float32, device="cuda")
+
+    result = moe_fused_mul_sum(
+        inputs=expert_outputs,
+        topk_weights=topk_weights,
+        outputs=output,
+        topk_ids=topk_ids,
+        is_ep=True,
+    )
+
+    assert result is output
+    assert result.dtype == torch.float32
+    assert torch.isfinite(result).all()
+    torch.testing.assert_close(
+        result,
+        torch.tensor(
+            [[0.5, 1.0], [3.0, 4.0], [0.0, 0.0]],
+            dtype=torch.float32,
+            device="cuda",
+        ),
